SELECT s.id, s.supplier_id, s.period_start, s.period_end, s.currency, s.gross_cents, s.revenue_cents, s.effective_share_bps, s.order_count, s.status, s.note, s.generated_at, s.confirmed_at, s.paid_at, sp.name AS supplier_name FROM supplier_settlements s LEFT JOIN suppliers sp ON sp.id = s.supplier_id
ORDER BY s.period_start DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
